implementationSlices: S1 — After delivered dependencies/exact READY, validate BB-127/131 projections; implement factory/runner/reporter with pre/post identity, actual assertion events and report/evidence guards. Define exact policy and preview projection validators in browser-journey-verifier.js using browserContract. runner launches protected browser-journey-runner.cjs with fixed argv and explicit bounded JSON protocol; browser-journey-reporter.cjs records declared ASSERT ids only on completed awaited expect events and rejects duplicate/missing titles/ids. Rehash protected bytes, browser executable and preview bindings pre/post. Merge reporter ledger with exact single-project single-attempt Playwright JSON and retained trace hash; setup, unknown IDs, drift or evidenceStore failure return INCONCLUSIVE, actual assertion mismatch FAIL, all mandatory proofs PASS. runner.run({policy,preview,outputRoot,signal}) returns {exitCode,signal,timedOut,reportPath,tracePaths,ledgerPath,stdout,stderr}; factory validates all paths as owned regular files and caps before parsing. reporter onStepEnd accepts category expect only under exactly one declared ASSERT:<id> parent, error==null; onTestEnd requires one expectedStatus=passed/result status=passed/retry0. Capture assertion failure separately from runner/setup errors; no assertion event means INCONCLUSIVE. Runner explicitly sets trusted config testDir/protected journey, fullyParallel:false,workers:1,retries:0,timeout:policytimeout,expect.timeout:5000,use:{browserName:chromium,headless:true,serviceWorkers:block,trace:on,screenshot:off,video:off}; load reporter via protected module path. Seven ordered ids cover empty list, blank validation/no write, create/list, reload, update/reload. Verify exact ledger set and trace/report digests before cleanup. Factory createBrowserJourneyVerifier({resolvePolicy,resolvePreview,observePreview,runner,evidenceStore,now}) exposes verify on existing QA criterion request; policy/preview projections come from protected operator resolvers. Validate candidate/tree/config/fixture/browser and independent QA snapshot/release/environment/components pre/post. No candidate-selected config or authority. Fixed verdict: valid protected expect mismatch FAIL; setup/transport/timeout/coverage/drift/storage fault INCONCLUSIVE; all mandatory successful events plus exit0/postchecks/durable refs PASS. Evidence contains hashes and typed outcomes, not screenshot-only proof. Cleanup own runner/browser/temp roots, leave caller-owned preview, retain traces via evidenceStore before disposal. Runtime bounds: invocation30s/max120s, streams64KiB, JSON1MiB, trace25MiB.

S2 — Port embedded matrix into real Chromium fixtures. Each N1-N12 directly constructs createBrowserJourneyVerifier and invokes verify. Inject boundary faults separately; compose new adapter with existing QA/completion/publisher. browser-journey-verifier.test.js also injects the actual factory into createProductQaExecutionStrategy with independent runtimeObserver and protected AcceptanceSnapshot. Assert failed/unknown criterion cannot publish; successful criteria require all QA identities. Generic QA tests remain regressions only. Real browser happy path is mandatory and missing provision fails the focused command with explicit setup error, never skip. Calibrated seven mandatory ASSERT ids and all11 native browser cases are enumerated in researchEvidence.calibration; reuse this resolved fixed workload. Adapter-specific validation/report/trace controls use injected failures in the actual factory. The source-copy calibration is not mistaken for candidate/QA publication evidence. Implement verification-only fixture bootstrap in browser-journey-fixtures.cjs as browserContract.testProvisioning. Both focused and ordinary npm test invoke it once via test before-hook; native browser cases have no environment-dependent skip. Keep installation out of product adapter and candidate app. Verify exact package SRI/browser revision and bind actual fixture lock/browser hashes before each adapter invocation.

S3 — Retain exact clean-candidate criterion evidence; run declared focused/regression/docs checks and update Living docs. Independent Worker judgment/publication follow; fixtures alone are not delivery.
